body:
Also, one thing we are not doing good in IS V1 is that we do have movies that have five stars, but we are unable to refine only on them.

I would add this: if the Algolia stats reveals that there are some objects reaching the maximum rating, then show the refinement for ★★★★★ because it's useful for users.

And we can go even further, by denoting the available/unavailable ranges like how it's done today:

![2016-09-21-154338\_244x136\_scrot](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/123822/18713342/3c4a400a-8012-11e6-9d87-b362179cf1ae.png)
